title: Line Buffer
text: Store video lines and return neighborhood pixels, 2 inputs, 3 outputs, {Padding method} sets Method for padding the boundary of input image; {Neighborhood size} sets the size of output neighborhood, {Padding value} sets the value used to pad boundary of input image and {Line buffer size} sets the size of line memory buffer. Values come from the instance.

ports.name: ctrl
ports.summary: Control signals associated with pixel stream pixelcontrol bus

ports.name: pixel
ports.summary: Column of neighborhood column vector | matrix

ports.name: ctrl
ports.summary: Control signals accompanying output column pixelcontrol bus

ports.name: shiftEnable
ports.summary: Valid signal for neighborhood column scalar

params.name: Neighborhood size
params.values: Size of output neighborhood [3 3] (default) | 2-element row vector of integer dimensions

params.name: Padding method
params.values: Method for padding the boundary of input image Symmetric (default) | Constant | Replicate | Reflection | None

params.name: Padding value
params.values: Value used to pad boundary of input image 0 (default) | integer

params.name: Line buffer size
params.values: Size of line memory buffer 2048 (default) | positive integer
